summary_1line: Diti forgives Indra for dividing her unborn child, declaring the fragments will become the Maruts, as the sage later reaches Vishala and recounts the legend.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra raises his thunderbolt while the unborn child in Diti’s womb divides into seven radiant forms as she pleads for mercy.
Diti, sorrowful yet composed, blesses the seven newborn wind-spirits who glow like small gods around her.
The sage and the young princes arrive at the city of Vishala where King Pramati welcomes them at the palace gates.
